comment: Independent bones.c witness for restore.c restobjchn()'s ghostly age shift. A debug human Valkyrie goes to a new level 3, drops her two food rations (made on turn 1), kills a grid bug, waits about 40 turns, shoots herself with a wished wand of death, and saves bones on turn 48. A second game on another seed and clock goes to level 3 on turn 2 and loads the bones; restobjchn() moves each object's age from the dead hero's clock to this one's (age = moves - omoves + age), so the rations now date from turn -45. After a wished blessed potion of object detection, the hero teleports onto the rations and eats one: doeat() finds a non-corpse food item more than 30 turns old and draws rn2(7) for rotting (eat.c 3026-3031). The seeds, clocks and inputs were chosen for this path.
